title: Page moves while loading or scrolling (CLS, phone)
fix: See 'Layout shifts' below: it lists the element that moves.
Give images, ads, banners and widgets a fixed size (width/height or aspect-ratio).
Animate only transform and opacity, never width/height/top/margin.
check: Real-visitor CLS 0.1 or less on phone and desktop.

title: Page moves while loading or scrolling (CLS, desktop)
fix: See 'Layout shifts' below: it lists the element that moves.
Give images, ads, banners and widgets a fixed size.
check: Real-visitor CLS 0.1 or less on desktop.

title: Ad clicks skip the Cloudflare cache
fix: The clean URL is cached, but url?gclid=... is not: every ad click gets a new gclid, so every ad visitor waits for the server.
Cloudflare Cache Rule > Cache key > Query string: ignore gclid, fbclid, msclkid and utm_* (or ignore the whole query string for this page).
check: Ad-click URL shows cache HIT in the report.

title: Redirect removes gclid / utm from the ad-click URL
fix: A redirect (http to https, www, trailing slash) drops the query string. Google Ads then cannot track conversions.
Keep the query string in every redirect rule (Cloudflare / .htaccess: append the query string).
check: Report shows the gclid is kept after redirects.

title: Private files can be downloaded from the live site
fix: Delete them from the server now (.git folder, .env, backup .sql).
If .env or .git was public: change the passwords and keys inside them.
check: No files listed under 'Found'.

title: Cached page has a form security token (forms can fail)
fix: Cloudflare caches the HTML, so every visitor gets the same token. When it expires, the form fails without an error.
Use a honeypot field (a hidden input bots fill in) and check it in PHP, or load the token with JavaScript after the page loads.
check: No hidden csrf/token input in the cached HTML, and a test lead goes through.

title: Chat widget moves the page
fix: Show your own small chat button with a fixed size and position: fixed.
Load the chat script only when the user clicks that button, then open the chat.
A timer (setTimeout) does not fix it: the shift only happens later.
check: No chat element in 'Layout shifts'.

title: Main content shows late on phones (LCP)
fix: Make the hero image a normal , not a CSS background.
Host fonts and scripts on your own domain and preload the hero font.
Do not hide hero text behind a JavaScript animation.
check: Lighthouse mobile LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: JavaScript blocks the page on phones (TBT)
fix: Remove unused tags from Google Tag Manager.
Load chat, animation and slider scripts only when needed (on click or when the section is near the screen).
check: Lighthouse mobile TBT 200 ms or less.

title: Scripts keep the phone busy after the page loads
fix: See 'Late requests' below for scripts that load after the page.
Load third-party scripts on first click/scroll instead of on a timer, and remove ones you do not need.
check: Real-visitor blocking time 300 ms or less.

title: Page keeps loading things for a long time
fix: Timers (setTimeout) that load GTM, chat or libraries keep the page busy. GTmetrix waits for all of them.
Load them on user interaction or when needed, not on a timer.
check: Network quiet within 8 s (GTmetrix 'Fully Loaded Time' should drop too).

title: Cloudflare does not cache the page
fix: Cloudflare > Caching > Cache Rules: this path = Eligible for cache, Edge TTL 1 hour.
In the same rule, Cache key > Query string: ignore gclid, fbclid, msclkid and utm_* (every ad click has a new gclid).
Purge the cache after every deploy.
Forms: do not put a security token in the HTML (everyone would get the same cached token). Use a honeypot field, or load the token with JavaScript after the page loads.
check: Header cf-cache-status shows HIT.

title: Server is slow to build the page (backend time)
fix: Cache the page on Cloudflare (see cache rule).
Check slow PHP code or database calls on this page.
check: Backend time under 600 ms in the report (under 100 ms when Cloudflare caches the page). This is server work only, so it does not depend on where you test from.

title: Server sometimes takes very long to answer (measured from this laptop)
fix: Cache the page on Cloudflare so visitors do not wait for the server (see cache rule).
Ask the hosting (Namecheap) about slow PHP or a busy shared server if it continues.
check: Slowest of 3 tries under 3 s (ads visitors leave if the page is blank that long).

title: Fonts load from another site
fix: Host the font files (woff2) on your own domain.
Preload the font used in the hero.
check: No fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com in 'External files'.

title: Scripts or styles load from a public CDN
fix: Download the file and host it on your own domain, load it with defer.
check: No jsdelivr/unpkg/cdnjs in 'External files'.

title: Images without width and height
fix: Add width and height to every so the browser keeps the space.
check: 0 images without size.

title: Page is heavy
fix: Resize images to the size they are shown (srcset), WebP/AVIF quality 70-75.
Remove unused JavaScript.
check: Page weight under 1500 KB.

title: Real phone visitors see the page jump (Google data)
fix: Fix the layout shift problems in this report first.
Google data is a 28-day average: it improves slowly after the fix.
check: Google phone CLS 0.1 or less (re-check about 4 weeks after the fix).

title: Real phone visitors wait for the main content (Google data)
fix: Fix server speed (cache) and the hero image/fonts first.
check: Google phone LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: Page reacts slowly to taps on phones (INP, Google data)
fix: Remove or delay heavy scripts (GTM tags, chat, sliders).
Keep click handlers short; do heavy work later (setTimeout 0 / requestIdleCallback).
check: Google phone INP 200 ms or less.

title: Ad visitors on phones see the page jump (Cloudflare data, last 7 days)
fix: Fix the layout shift problems in this report first.
check: Cloudflare phone CLS 0.1 or less a few days after the fix.

title: Ad visitors on phones wait for the main content (Cloudflare data)
fix: Fix server speed (cache) and the hero image/fonts first.
check: Cloudflare phone LCP 2.5 s or less.

title: Page reacts slowly to taps for ad visitors (Cloudflare data)
fix: Remove or delay heavy scripts (GTM tags, chat, sliders).
check: Cloudflare phone INP 200 ms or less.

title: GTmetrix performance below 90%
fix: Fix the other problems first, then run the audit again.
check: GTmetrix Grade A, performance 90% or more.

title: No Google tag on the page (Google Ads cannot count leads)
fix: No Google Tag Manager (gtm.js) or Google tag (gtag.js) loaded in the first 10 s, even after a scroll.
Add the GTM snippet to the page head, or check it is not removed by a cookie banner or a PHP condition.
check: 'Tags when the page opens' lists Google Tag Manager or Google tag.

title: Google Ads conversion fires when the page opens (every visitor counts as a lead)
fix: The conversion tag must fire only on the thank-you page or after a successful submit.
In GTM: change the trigger of the Google Ads Conversion tag from 'All Pages' to the thank-you page or the form-success event.
check: Report shows no 'Google Ads conversion' before Submit.

title: Google Ads conversion does not fire after the form is sent
fix: Google Ads gets no lead, so Smart Bidding learns from wrong data and wastes budget.
Check the GTM trigger of the Google Ads Conversion tag (thank-you page URL or form-success event) and publish the GTM container.
check: After Submit (or on the thank-you page) the report shows 'Google Ads conversion'.

title: Form does not send (nothing happens after Submit)
fix: The test filled every visible field and pressed Submit, but no request left the page.
Look at 'Fields the browser did not accept' and the browser console. Fill the form by hand once to compare: if it works by hand, our test data did not fit (tell the team).
check: Report shows 'Form sends to: POST ...'.

title: Error after the form is sent
fix: The thank-you page or the form handler shows an error or a 404/500 answer.
Open the page shown under 'Found' and fix the error (PHP error log on the server).
check: No errors under 'Found' after a test with --submit on staging.

title: Meta pixel loads but sends no PageView
fix: fbevents.js is loaded, but no facebook.com/tr request was sent.
Check the pixel ID and that fbq('track', 'PageView') runs.
check: Report shows 'Meta event PageView' when the page opens.

title: robots.txt blocks Google's AdsBot (ads can be disapproved)
fix: Google Ads checks landing pages with AdsBot. When robots.txt blocks it, ads get 'Destination not working'.
Remove the 'User-agent: AdsBot-Google' (or AdsBot-Google-Mobile) group that disallows this page.
check: Report says robots.txt does not block AdsBot.

title: Broken links or images on the page
fix: Each line under 'Found' answered 404, a server error, or nothing.
Fix the link or image path, or remove it. Check privacy policy and terms links too: Google Ads needs them.
check: No broken links or images in the next audit.

title: Phone basics fail (Lighthouse)
fix: viewport: add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
font-size: body text at least 16px on phones.
is-on-https: load every image, script and font over https.
errors-in-console: open the page with F12 > Console and fix the red errors.
check: These items are gone from 'Found' in the next audit.

title: Form or text hard to use (Lighthouse accessibility)
fix: label: every form field needs a <label> (or aria-label); phones use it for autofill too.
color-contrast: make text darker or bigger on its background (buttons too).
image-aspect-ratio: show images in the same width/height ratio as the file.
check: These items are gone from 'Found' in the next audit.
